summary: UWM Holdings commenced a $400M rights offering under its effective Form S-3ASR shelf, issuing one subscription right per Class A share held on the October 2, 2026 record date. Each right buys 0.57 shares at the greater of $2.00 or 85% of the 10-day VWAP ending three trading days before the November 12, 2026 expiration. Oversubscription rights are available. SFS Group Capital and Mat Ishbia backstop the deal. With the record-date close at $1.26, rights cannot trade on the NYSE until the stock exceeds $2.00, leaving a deep out-of-the-money overhang and dilution risk if the backstop absorbs shares.
